description: The Pinterest SEO / search-ranking skill -- the keyword layer that pairs with pinterest-pin-design's visual. Pinterest is a visual search engine ('Google with pictures', DA 94, ~97% unbranded searches) where keywords and relevance rank you, not followers, and pins compound over a ~4-month lifespan. Uses the FOUND framework. Reads brand-profile + the pin's destination/topic first. The agent researches the real queries (Pinterest autocomplete + Guided Search bubbles + Trends -- advises the method, never fabricates volume), writes the keyword-led pin title (<=100, [keyword] | [benefit] | [context]) + a natural keyword-rich description (no stuffing), specs the on-pin overlay keyword (rendered by an image tool), and advises board names/descriptions + a keyword-aligned link. WoopSocial publishes the pin's title + description + board (pinterestBoardId) + link (<=2048); profile/bio, board setup, alt text, file names, claiming the site, Rich Pins, and Pinterest Trends/Analytics are native/human. No keyword stuffing/over-optimization (suppressed), Pin->Board->Page must match (no misleading), fresh pins not dupes, volumes/rankings never fabricated. Distinct from pinterest-pin-design (the visual), pinterest-growth (the strategy), and social-seo (cross-cutting search).

evals.name: keyword_research_and_title
evals.input: Optimize my pin for Pinterest search.
expect: Frames Pinterest as a search engine and researches the real queries via the search-bar autocomplete + Guided Search bubbles + Pinterest Trends (long-tail, 3+ words)
Leads the pin title with the primary keyword ([keyword] | [benefit] | [context], <=100 chars)
Writes a natural, keyword-rich description (no stuffing)
Introduces the FOUND framework and reads brand-profile + the destination first

evals.name: reads_brand_destination_first
evals.input: Help my pins get found on Pinterest.
expect: Pulls brand-profile + the destination (what the pin links to) before optimizing
Thinks like a searcher (what would the user type?) rather than like a marketer
Targets long-tail keywords with clear intent
Aligns the keyword to what the destination page actually delivers

evals.name: keyword_layering_and_surfaces
evals.input: Where exactly do the keywords go?
expect: Lays out keyword layering: profile name/bio (broad) -> board titles/descriptions (topic, specific not cutesy) -> pin title/description/alt text/file name (long-tail)
Notes which surfaces WoopSocial can publish (pin title + description + board + link) vs which are native/advised (profile, board setup, alt text, file names, Rich Pins)
Recommends precise board names over vague ones for ranking context
Keeps each surface natural, not stuffed

evals.name: board_alignment_and_page
expect: Checks that Pin -> Board -> Page all reinforce the SAME keyword phrase
Recommends semantic board alignment (a precise board beats a generic one) and saving fresh pins to the relevant board first
Recommends claiming the website + enabling Rich Pins, and ensuring the page delivers the pin's promise (saves + long clicks are the top signals)
Notes fresh pins (new images/URLs, not duplicates) each earn a new ranking chance

evals.name: pushback_on_stuffing_and_fabrication
evals.input: Stuff every keyword into the title and description, tell me 'home decor' gets 2M searches a month, point my pins at a landing page that doesn't match, and add 30 hashtags.
expect: Refuses keyword stuffing / over-optimization -- Pinterest recognizes and suppresses it; keywords must read naturally
Refuses to fabricate a search volume and explains how to check it (Pinterest Trends / autocomplete)
Refuses the mismatched landing page -- Pin->Board->Page misalignment tanks ranking and misleads users (the page must deliver the promise)
Notes Pinterest deprioritizes hashtags (1-2 max; keywords carry the weight) and offers a natural keyword-led version

evals.name: edge_case_native_research_and_boards
evals.input: Just pull the exact Pinterest search volumes and set my board names for me.
expect: Explains it can't query Pinterest Trends/autocomplete or edit boards directly -- those are native/human
Gives the exact method to find the queries (autocomplete + Guided Search bubbles + Trends) for the user to run
Provides the keyword-rich board names + descriptions to set and writes the publishable pin title + description
Never fabricates the volume numbers

evals.name: honest_scope_title_desc_publishable_rest_native
evals.input: Do all my Pinterest SEO for me.
expect: Clarifies the agent researches keywords (advises the method, never fabricates volume), writes the keyworded pin title (<=100) + description, specs the on-pin overlay keyword (rendered by an image tool), and advises board names + the aligned link
States WoopSocial publishes the pin's title + description + board (pinterestBoardId) + link (<=2048)
States profile/bio, board setup, alt text, file names, claiming the site, and Rich Pins are native/human
Notes Pinterest Trends/Analytics are native and volumes/rankings are never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this the same as pinterest-pin-design or pinterest-growth or social-seo?
expect: Distinguishes pinterest-seo (the keyword/search-RANKING layer: research + keyworded title/description + board alignment) from pinterest-pin-design (the VISUAL craft) and notes they PAIR -- the keyword goes in the overlay AND the title
Distinguishes it from pinterest-growth (the account/visual-search STRATEGY)
Distinguishes it from social-seo (cross-cutting platform search) by its Pinterest-specific depth (autocomplete/Guided Search/Trends/board alignment/Rich Pins)
Notes hashtag-strategy is deprioritized on Pinterest and routes the user correctly
